member.summary: 由于我们只需要支持添加、移除和包含检查，并且索引保证唯一，我们可以使用打包的位字段。每个位代表一个索引的包含状态。(Since we only ever need to support add, remove and contains checks, and because the indices are guaranteed unique, we can just use packed bitfields. Each bit represents one index's containment state.)
member.remarks: 在最坏的情况下，这可以增长到 (indexCount / 8) 字节，但仍然比使用字典或集合小得多。16384 个物体仅需 2KB。即使你有 1000 个批次都达到这个大小，这也是一个不令人担忧的存储量。(This can grow up to the number of (indexCount / 8) bytes in the worst case, but that is much, much smaller than using a dictionary or set. 16384 bodies would only take 2KB. Even if you have 1000 batches all at that size, it's a pretty unconcerning amount of storage.) (而 1000 个批次是一个疯狂的病态情况。大多数模拟的批次少于 20 个。)(And to be clear, 1000 batches is a crazy pathological number. Most simulations will have less than 20 batches.)

member.name: T:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickDictionary`3
member.summary: 支持常量时间添加和删除键值对的容器，同时保持快速迭代时间。以便宜的安全性为代价提供非常直接的信息访问。(Container supporting constant time adds and removes of key-value pairs while preserving fast iteration times. Offers very direct access to information at the cost of safety.)

remarks.para: 使用此类型时要非常小心。它在性能的祭坛上牺牲了很多；一些值得注意的问题包括：它是一个值类型，复制它会破坏很多功能而不加小心，不能有效地默认构造，它暴露内部结构供用户修改，它很少检查输入错误，枚举器不检查枚举期间的修改，它允许不安全添加，如果用户不管理容量可能会出问题，它在抽象的内存块上工作，内部可能是一个可能被拉走的指针，它无法（也不能）检查提供的内存是否返回到同一个池中。(Be very careful when using this type. It has sacrificed a lot upon the altar of performance; a few notable issues include: it is a value type and copying it around will break things without extreme care, it cannot be validly default-constructed, it exposes internal structures to user modification, it rarely checks input for errors, the enumerator doesn't check for mid-enumeration modification, it allows unsafe addition that can break if the user doesn't manage the capacity, it works on top of an abstracted memory blob which might internally be a pointer that could be rugpulled, it does not (and is incapable of) checking that provided memory gets returned to the same pool that it came from.)

注意，实现非常简单。在假设冲突率非常低的情况下，它使用单步线性探测。建议使用较大的表容量；这牺牲了一些内存以换取简单性和运行时性能。(Note that the implementation is extremely simple. It uses single-step linear probing under the assumption of very low collision rates. A generous table capacity is recommended; this trades some memory for simplicity and runtime performance.)

member.typeparam: 容器持有的键的类型。(Type of key held by the container.)
容器持有的值的类型。(Type of value held by the container.)
使用的相等性测试器和哈希计算器的类型。(Type of the equality tester and hash calculator used.)

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickDictionary`3.Table
member.summary: 字典表的后备内存。值根据 EqualityComparer 的哈希函数分布。包含 0 的槽未使用且不指向任何内容。包含更高值的槽等于元素在 Span 中的索引加一。(Backing memory of the dictionary's table. Values are distributed according to the EqualityComparer's hash function. Slots containing 0 are unused and point to nothing. Slots containing higher values are equal to one plus the index of an element in the Span.)

member.name: T:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickList`1
member.summary: 支持类似列表行为的容器，构建在非托管缓冲区之上。(Container supporting list-like behaviors built on top of unmanaged buffers.)
member.remarks: 使用此类型时要非常小心。它在性能的祭坛上牺牲了很多；一些值得注意的问题包括：它是一个值类型，复制它会破坏很多功能而不加小心，不能有效地默认构造，它暴露内部结构供用户修改，它很少检查输入错误，枚举器不检查枚举期间的修改，它允许不安全添加，如果用户不管理容量可能会出问题，它在抽象的内存块上工作，内部可能是一个可能被拉走的指针，它无法（也不能）检查提供的内存是否返回到同一个池中。(Be very careful when using this type. It has sacrificed a lot upon the altar of performance; a few notable issues include: it is a value type and copying it around will break things without extreme care, it cannot be validly default-constructed, it exposes internal structures to user modification, it rarely checks input for errors, the enumerator doesn't check for mid-enumeration modification, it allows unsafe addition that can break if the user doesn't manage the capacity, it works on top of an abstracted memory blob which might internally be a pointer that could be rugpulled, it does not (and is incapable of) checking that provided memory gets returned to the same pool that it came from.)
member.typeparam: 列表中元素的类型。(Type of the elements in the list.)

member.remarks: 使用此类型时要非常小心。它在性能的祭坛上牺牲了很多；一些值得注意的问题包括：它是一个值类型，复制它会破坏很多功能而不加小心，不能有效地默认构造，它暴露内部结构供用户修改，它很少检查输入错误，枚举器不检查枚举期间的修改，它允许不安全添加，如果用户不管理容量可能会出问题，它在抽象的内存块上工作，内部可能是一个可能被拉走的指针，它无法（也不能）检查提供的内存是否返回到同一个池中。(Be very careful when using this type. It has sacrificed a lot upon the altar of performance; a few notable issues include: it is a value type and copying it around will break things without extreme care, it cannot be validly default-constructed, it exposes internal structures to user modification, it rarely checks input for errors, the enumerator doesn't check for mid-enumeration modification, it allows unsafe addition that can break if the user doesn't manage the capacity, it works on top of an abstracted memory blob which might internally be a pointer that could be rugpulled, it does not (and is incapable of) checking that provided memory gets returned to the same pool that it came from.)
member.typeparam: 队列中元素的类型。(Type of the elements in the queue.)

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickQueue`1.Count

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickQueue`1.CapacityMask
member.summary: 基于当前跨度长度的掩码，用于执行快速模运算；要求跨度长度为 2 的幂。(Mask based on the current span length used to do fast modulo operations; requires that the span has a power of 2 length.)

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickQueue`1.Span
member.summary: 获取包含队列元素的后备内存。索引从 FirstIndex 到 LastIndex（包括）持有实际数据。所有其他数据未定义。注意环绕：即使计数大于 0，LastIndex 也可能小于 FirstIndex！(Gets the backing memory containing the elements of the queue. Indices from FirstIndex to LastIndex inclusive hold actual data. All other data is undefined. Watch out for wrap around; LastIndex can be less than FirstIndex even when count > 0!)

member.returns: 给定逻辑队列索引在后备数组中对应的索引。(The index in in the backing array corresponding to the given logical queue index.)

member.name: M:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickQueue`1.Resize(BepuUtilities.Memory.Buffer{`0}@,BepuUtilities.Memory.Buffer{`0}@)
member.summary: 将队列的后备内存跨度替换为新的跨度。如果新跨度更小，队列的计数将被截断，多余的元素将被丢弃。旧跨度不会被清除或返回给任何池；如果需要池化或清除，用户必须自行处理。(Swaps out the queue's backing memory span for a new span. If the new span is smaller, the queue's count is truncated and the extra elements are dropped. The old span is not cleared or returned to any pool; if it needs to be pooled or cleared, the user must handle it.)

member.name: T:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickSet`2
member.summary: 支持常量时间添加和移除的容器，同时保持快速迭代时间。以便宜的安全性为代价提供非常直接的信息访问。(Container supporting constant time adds and removes while preserving fast iteration times. Offers very direct access to information at the cost of safety.)

remarks.para: 使用此类型时要非常小心。它在性能的祭坛上牺牲了很多；一些值得注意的问题包括：它是一个值类型，复制它会破坏很多功能而不加小心，不能有效地默认构造，它暴露内部结构供用户修改，它很少检查输入错误，枚举器不检查枚举期间的修改，它允许不安全添加，如果用户不管理容量可能会出问题，它在抽象的内存块上工作，内部可能是一个可能被拉走的指针，它无法（也不能）检查提供的内存是否返回到同一个池中。(Be very careful when using this type. It has sacrificed a lot upon the altar of performance; a few notable issues include: it is a value type and copying it around will break things without extreme care, it cannot be validly default-constructed, it exposes internal structures to user modification, it rarely checks input for errors, the enumerator doesn't check for mid-enumeration modification, it allows unsafe addition that can break if the user doesn't manage the capacity, it works on top of an abstracted memory blob which might internally be a pointer that could be rugpulled, it does not (and is incapable of) checking that provided memory gets returned to the same pool that it came from.)

注意，实现非常简单。在假设冲突率非常低的情况下，它使用单步线性探测。建议使用较大的表容量；这牺牲了一些内存以换取简单性和运行时性能。(Note that the implementation is extremely simple. It uses single-step linear probing under the assumption of very low collision rates. A generous table capacity is recommended; this trades some memory for simplicity and runtime performance.)

使用的相等性测试器和哈希计算器的类型。(Type of the equality tester and hash calculator used.)

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickSet`2.TablePowerOffset
member.summary: 相对于键/值跨度大小的期望表大小，以 2 的幂表示。表容量目标将为 elementCapacityTarget * 2^TablePowerOffset。(Desired size of the table relative to the size of the key/value spans in terms of a power of 2. Table capacity target will be elementCapacityTarget * 2^TablePowerOffset.)

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickSet`2.Table
member.summary: 集合表的后备内存。值根据 EqualityComparer 的哈希函数分布。包含 0 的槽未使用且不指向任何内容。包含更高值的槽等于元素在 Span 中的索引加一。(Backing memory of the set's table. Values are distributed according to the EqualityComparer's hash function. Slots containing 0 are unused and point to nothing. Slots containing higher values are equal to one plus the index of an element in the Span.)

member.name: F:BepuUtilities.Collections.QuickSet`2.Span

member.name: T:BepuUtilities.IThreadDispatcher
member.summary: 为模拟提供多线程调度原语、线程计数和每线程资源池。(Provides multithreading dispatch primitives, a thread count, and per thread resource pools for the simulation to use.)

remarks.para: 注意，模拟不需要真正的负载均衡 for 循环实现。所需要的只是一种启动一些线程的方法。所有使用多线程的系统往往具有某种形式的域特定负载平衡，这是通用线程池或并行 for 循环实现无法比拟的。模拟也倾向于尽可能保持调度次数较低。这两点结合起来降低了对高度优化的调度器的需求。(Note that the simulation does not require a true load balancing forloop implementation. All that's needed is a way to jumpstart some threads. All systems which use multithreading tend to have some form of domain specific load balancing that a general purpose thread pool or parallel for loop implementation couldn't match. The simulation also tends to keep the number of dispatches as low as it can. Combined, these two things reduce the importance of a very highly optimized dispatcher.)

当用户希望共享其他线程池，但没有时间保证极高的性能和高品质的负载平衡时，这一点很重要。不必担心这些问题，他们可以简单地包装任何已有的实现，它很可能工作正常。(This is important when a user wants to share some other thread pool, but doesn't have the time to guarantee extremely high performance and high quality load balancing. Instead of worrying about that, they can just wrap whatever implementation they happen to have and it'll probably work fine.)

member.name: P:BepuUtilities.IThreadDispatcher.ThreadCount
member.summary: 获取线程调度器中可用的工作线程数量。(Gets the number of workers available in the thread dispatcher.)
member.remarks: 注意，某些系统（如求解器）期望 ThreadCount 由真正独立的线程支持，即使一个线程被阻塞，其他线程也能继续执行。如果 ThreadCount 不代表独立线程，则会发生死锁。(Note that some systems (like the solver) expect the ThreadCount to be backed by truly independent threads capable of progression even when one is blocked. If the ThreadCount doesn't represent independent threads, deadlocks will occur.)

member.name: P:BepuUtilities.IThreadDispatcher.UnmanagedContext
member.summary: 获取与当前调度关联的非托管上下文（如果有）。(Gets the unmanaged context associated with the current dispatch, if any.)
member.remarks: 这旨在帮助将信息传递给工作线程，特别是那些用函数指针定义的、不能简单地在闭包中包含额外状态的工作线程。(This is intended to help pass information to workers, especially those defined with function pointers that can't just include extra state in closures.)

member.name: P:BepuUtilities.IThreadDispatcher.ManagedContext
member.summary: 获取与当前调度关联的托管上下文（如果有）。(Gets the managed context associated with the current dispatch, if any.)
member.remarks: 这旨在帮助将信息传递给工作线程，特别是那些用函数指针定义的、不能简单地在闭包中包含额外状态的工作线程。(This is intended to help pass information to workers, especially those defined with function pointers that can't just include extra state in closures.)

member.param: 将在每个工作线程上调用的函数指针。与 签名匹配。(Function pointer to be invoked on every worker. Matches the signature of the .)
要调度的最大工作线程数。(Maximum number of workers to dispatch.)
调度的非托管上下文。(Unmanaged context of the dispatch.)
调度的托管上下文。(Managed context of the dispatch.)

member.summary: 使用空上下文调度所有可用的工作线程。(Dispatches all the available workers with a null context.)

member.name: P:BepuUtilities.IThreadDispatcher.WorkerPools
member.summary: 获取与线程工作线程关联的内存池集合。(Gets the set of memory pools associated with thread workers.)
member.remarks: 在模拟中对这些工作线程池的所有使用都保证在函数返回前将线程池内存归还。换句话说，线程内存池仅用于严格短暂的内存，模拟永远不会在将 作为输入的函数范围之外持有它。(All usages of these worker pools within the simulation are guaranteed to return thread pool memory before the function returns. In other words, thread memory pools are used for strictly ephemeral memory, and it will never be held by the simulation outside the scope of a function that takes the IThreadDispatcher as input.)

member.name: M:BepuUtilities.Memory.IUnmanagedMemoryPool.ReturnUnsafely(System.Int32)
member.summary: 通过 id 将缓冲区返回到池中。(Returns a buffer to the pool by id.)
member.param: 要返回到池中的缓冲区的 id。(Id of the buffer to return to the pool.)
member.remarks: 按照惯例，池会将传入的缓冲区清零。这成本很低，并能避免各种各样的错误（要么直接，要么通过强制快速失败）。这个“不安全”的重载只应在有理由绕过清除的情况下使用；命名旨在劝阻随意使用。(Pools zero out the passed-in buffer by convention. This costs very little and avoids a wide variety of bugs (either directly or by forcing fast failure). This "Unsafe" overload should be used only in cases where there's a reason to bypass the clear; the naming is intended to dissuade casual use.)

member.name: T:BepuUtilities.Memory.ManagedIdPool
member.summary: 管理标识符值的池。从池中获取 id 会挑选一个之前被获取并返回过的数字，如果没有可用的，则选择大于任何现有 id 的最小值。(Manages a pool of identifier values. Grabbing an id from the pool picks a number that has been picked and returned before, or if none of those are available, the minimum value greater than any existing id.)
member.remarks: 这与在非托管内存上操作的 IdPool 形成对比。此版本仅存在于支持无法使用非托管版本的使用场景——例如，在 BufferPool 中。虽然实现可以共享，但这样做需要创建足够多的支持基础设施，因此使用仅托管的版本更简单。(This contrasts with the IdPool which operates on unmanaged memory. This version only exists to support use cases where the unmanaged version can't be used- for example, in the BufferPool. While the implementation can be shared, doing so involves creating enough supporting infrastructure that it's simpler to have a managed-only version.)
